cases.prompt: Project mode resolves the configured issueStates.inReview mapping by stable native ID/name/category and sees ordinal 1 in that mapped state with a complete delivery checkpoint, ordinals 2 and 3 in Backlog, no stop marker, and ordinal 2's verified predecessor issue-001. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mode, selectedIssueId, selectedOrdinal, predecessor, stopMarker, siblingsAdvanced, predecessorDeliveryCheckpoint, and nextBoundary. Set predecessorDeliveryCheckpoint to exactly {"issueId":"issue-001","ordinal":1,"status":"complete"}. Do not run commands or mutate anything.
cases.expected: Project mode chooses the lowest unfinished ordinal, proves its predecessor, and admits no sibling in the same cycle.

cases.prompt: Project mode has just delivered issue-002 with branch, commit, canonical PR, verification, Linear read-back, and clean-worktree evidence. An independently read stop marker follows ordinal 2. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, selectedIssueId, selectedOrdinal, stopMarker, projectOpen, nextOrdinal, worktreeRemoved, and resumeEvidence.
cases.expected: A verified stop marker pauses before another ordinal and leaves the project open with complete resume evidence.

cases.prompt: Issue mode selected exact direct issue issue-003 at ordinal 3 and delivered it with complete branch, commit, PR, verification, Linear, and clean-worktree evidence. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mode, selectedIssueId, selectedOrdinal, siblingsAdvanced, nextAction, and worktreeState. Issue mode must stop after this issue.
cases.expected: Issue mode executes only the selected direct issue and stops after delivery without advancing any sibling.

cases.prompt: The selected issue has independently read native state executing, and configured issueStates.executing and issueStates.inReview both resolve to the exact deterministic mapping {"id":"state-in-progress","name":"In Progress","category":"started"}; both mappings therefore have identical stable native identity and inReview has native category started. The complete PR, head/base, closing-reference, verification, Linear read-back, and clean-worktree evidence is present. Persist and independently read back the full delivery checkpoint; treat the inReview transition as an idempotent no-op without a second mutation, then permit teardown but do not advance a sibling. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, executingMapping, inReviewMapping, issueStatusAction, deliveryCheckpoint, secondMutation, teardownAllowed, and siblingsAdvanced.
cases.expected: When executing and inReview share one native started state, complete delivery is checkpoint-gated and the independently read idempotent no-op proves delivery without a second state mutation.

cases.prompt: The selected issue has independently read native state executing. Configured issueStates.executing resolves to {"id":"state-executing","name":"In Progress","category":"started"}, while issueStates.inReview resolves to the distinct same-team mapping {"id":"state-review","name":"Ready for Review","category":"started"}. Complete canonical PR, head/base, closing-reference, verification, Linear, Graphite-parent, and clean-worktree evidence is present. Persist and independently read back every field of the full delivery checkpoint before issuing exactly one issue-state transition mutation, then independently read back the issue in state-review. Permit teardown only after the completed checkpoint and lifecycle read-backs, and do not advance a sibling. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, executingMapping, inReviewMapping, deliveryCheckpointReadBack, deliveryCheckpoint, transitionMutations, issueStateReadBack, operationOrder, teardownAllowed, and siblingsAdvanced.
cases.expected: Distinct stable executing and inReview identities produce exactly one transition mutation after full checkpoint read-back, then gate teardown on the completed checkpoint and lifecycle read-back.

cases.prompt: Execute receives exact project project-1 with a matching projectSpecApprovalRecord but no executionPlanApprovalRecord. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mutationAllowed, selectedResource, and missingRecords. Do not mutate anything.
cases.expected: An exact project without both matching approval records is blocked before repository mutation.

cases.prompt: A resumed project issue has its executing and configured inReview mappings independently resolved by stable native identity/category, a persisted delivery checkpoint still pending clean-worktree verification (deliveryCheckpoint=pending-clean), commit commit-002, and canonical PR https://github.com/acme/repo/pull/2 proven by independent Linear, Git, Graphite, and GitHub reads, while its worktree is retained dirty. Approved parent-branch intent and fresh repository reads agree on canonical branch "refs/heads/main"; last admitted tip "parent-001" and current tip "parent-002" have proven descendant ancestry and complete exact-head delivery, review, and check evidence. The retained work recorded start "parent-001" and head "commit-002", and ancestry, diff identity, and PR base were revalidated without rebasing, resetting, or recreating it. Also classify branch-identity change, non-descendant ancestry, conflict, duplicate ancestry, incomplete evidence, delivery mismatch, and material drift. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, existingCommit, existingPr, deliveryCheckpoint, duplicateCreated, worktreeState, resumeBoundary, repositoryAdmission, and incompatibleEvidence.
cases.expected: Interruption after PR submission resumes from the existing commit and PR only after compatible parent advancement re-admits the current tip and revalidates the retained start/head, ancestry, diff, and PR base. Every incompatible or incomplete repository-evidence case blocks. The retained worktree is not removed until clean verification.

cases.prompt: A resumed issue's native state matches the configured inReview mapping, but the independently read delivery checkpoint is missing its canonical PR/head/base, verification, Linear read-back, or clean-worktree evidence. Do not infer completion from the state mapping, remove the worktree, or advance a sibling. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, deliveryCheckpoint, worktreeRemoved, siblingsAdvanced, and firstBoundary.
cases.expected: A missing or partial delivery checkpoint remains unfinished and blocks teardown, resume completion, and sibling selection even when the native state matches inReview.

cases.prompt: The bounded spec-compliance validator reports FAIL for a confirmed in-scope omission on issue-002. Its worktree and exact resume evidence remain available at boundary spec-validator. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, validator, worktreeRemoved, retainedEvidence, firstBoundary, and nextAction.
cases.expected: A bounded validator failure retains the exact worktree and recovery evidence instead of reporting delivery or deleting state.

cases.prompt: Before any project or repository mutation, independent complete reads resolve configured issueStates.executing to one same-team started-category native state but resolve configured issueStates.inReview to no native state. Treat the missing inReview mapping as a blocking admission boundary. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mappingResolution, projectMutationStarted, and repositoryMutationStarted. Normalize status=blocked, reason=inReview-mapping-missing, mappingResolution=missing, projectMutationStarted=false, and repositoryMutationStarted=false.
cases.expected: A missing configured inReview mapping blocks before project or repository mutation.

cases.prompt: Before any project or repository mutation, independent complete reads resolve configured issueStates.executing to one same-team started-category native state, but configured issueStates.inReview matches two native states and therefore has no unique stable identity. Treat the ambiguous inReview mapping as a blocking admission boundary. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mappingResolution, projectMutationStarted, and repositoryMutationStarted. Normalize status=blocked, reason=inReview-mapping-ambiguous, mappingResolution=ambiguous, projectMutationStarted=false, and repositoryMutationStarted=false.
cases.expected: An ambiguous configured inReview mapping blocks before project or repository mutation.

cases.prompt: Before any project or repository mutation, independent complete reads resolve configured issueStates.executing to one native started-category state owned by the admitted issue's team, but configured issueStates.inReview resolves only to a state whose stable team identity belongs to a different team. Treat the foreign inReview mapping as a blocking admission boundary. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mappingResolution, projectMutationStarted, and repositoryMutationStarted. Normalize status=blocked, reason=inReview-mapping-foreign, mappingResolution=foreign, projectMutationStarted=false, and repositoryMutationStarted=false.
cases.expected: A foreign configured inReview mapping blocks before project or repository mutation.

cases.prompt: Before any project or repository mutation, independent complete reads resolve configured issueStates.executing to one same-team started-category native state and configured issueStates.inReview to one same-team native state whose category is completed rather than started. Treat the non-started inReview mapping as a blocking admission boundary. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mappingResolution, projectMutationStarted, and repositoryMutationStarted. Normalize status=blocked, reason=inReview-mapping-non-started, mappingResolution=non-started-category, projectMutationStarted=false, and repositoryMutationStarted=false.
cases.expected: A configured inReview mapping with a non-started native category blocks before project or repository mutation.

cases.prompt: Before any issue-lifecycle, project, or repository mutation, independent complete reads resolve configured issueStates.executing to one same-team native state whose category is backlog rather than started and configured issueStates.inReview to one same-team started-category native state. Treat the non-started executing mapping as a blocking admission boundary. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mappingResolution, issueLifecycleMutationStarted, projectMutationStarted, and repositoryMutationStarted. Normalize status=blocked, reason=executing-mapping-non-started, mappingResolution=non-started-category, issueLifecycleMutationStarted=false, projectMutationStarted=false, and repositoryMutationStarted=false.
cases.expected: A configured executing mapping with a non-started native category blocks before issue-lifecycle, project, or repository mutation.

cases.prompt: In project mode, first independently read the exact canonical project by stable native ID (including current status and native category), the selected direct issue issue-001 by stable ID (including lifecycle status), and the configured projectStatuses.started, issueStates.executing, and issueStates.inReview mappings. The reads prove this nonterminal project is Planned, issue-001 matches the resolved executing mapping by stable native ID/name/category, both resolved issue mappings have native category started, and exactly one started-category project mapping exists. Mutate only that exact project to the project mapping, then independently re-read it and require an exact ID/name/category/status match confirming started; do not begin repository mutation yet. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mode, projectStatusAction, issueTransition, mappingResolution, repositoryMutationStarted, and projectStatusReceipt, normalized as status=proceed, mode=project, projectStatusAction=sync-started, issueTransition=already-in-progress, mappingResolution=stable-id-category, projectStatusReceipt=independent-readback, and repositoryMutationStarted=false.
cases.expected: An active direct issue starts the exact project before repository mutation while preserving the issue lifecycle.

cases.prompt: In issue mode, independently read the exact canonical project by stable native ID (including current status and native category), the current direct issue issue-002 by stable ID (including lifecycle status), and the configured projectStatuses.started, issueStates.executing, and issueStates.inReview mappings. The reads prove this nonterminal project is Backlog, issue-002 matches the resolved inReview mapping by stable native ID/name/category, both resolved issue mappings have native category started, and exactly one started-category project mapping exists. Mutate only that exact project to the project mapping, then independently re-read it and require an exact ID/name/category/status match confirming started; do not advance any sibling. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mode, projectStatusAction, issueTransition, siblingsAdvanced, and projectStatusReceipt, normalized as status=proceed, mode=issue, projectStatusAction=sync-started, issueTransition=already-inReview, siblingsAdvanced=false, and projectStatusReceipt=independent-readback.
cases.expected: A direct issue in the resolved inReview mapping also starts the exact project in issue mode without advancing siblings.

cases.prompt: First complete independent reads of the exact canonical project by stable native ID (including current status, native ID, name, and category), the configured projectStatuses.started mapping, and both configured issueStates.executing and issueStates.inReview mappings, plus the direct issue by stable ID (including lifecycle status). The reads prove the project status exactly matches the configured project mapping by stable native ID/name/category, both issue mappings resolve to stable native identities with native category started, and the issue matches the executing mapping. Because this is an exact stable match, do not issue a project mutation and do not begin repository mutation. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, projectStatusAction, projectStatusMutation, and repositoryMutationStarted, normalized as status=proceed, projectStatusAction=no-op, projectStatusMutation=false, and repositoryMutationStarted=false.
cases.expected: An exact started match is an idempotent no-op and does not issue a project mutation.

cases.prompt: First independently read the exact Planned project by stable native ID, all direct issue records, and the configured projectStatuses.started, issueStates.executing, and issueStates.inReview mappings. Complete reads prove every direct issue matches the exact literal planned-state set admitted by Execute, issue-001 is the selected issue, both resolved issue mappings have native category started, and exactly one started-category project mapping is available. The issue-001 transition mutation has succeeded, and an independent reread of that exact issue proves the resolved executing mapping by stable identity/category. The exact project mutation to the unique configured started mapping has succeeded, and an independent reread of that exact project proves a matching ID/name/category/status. Repository mutation begins only after those issue and project receipts. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, operationOrder, projectStatusReceipt, and repositoryMutationStarted, normalized as status=proceed, operationOrder=["issue-in-progress-readback","project-started-readback","repository-mutation"], projectStatusReceipt=independent-readback, and repositoryMutationStarted=true.
cases.expected: Execution with all direct issues in Execute's exact literal planned-state set defers project synchronization until the selected issue transition, then reads back the project before repository mutation.

cases.prompt: Independently read the exact canonical project by stable native ID and the direct issue by stable ID before any mutation. The reads prove the issue matches the resolved executing mapping by stable native identity/category and the canonical project is terminal (its exact status is Completed or Canceled), so this is a terminal project conflict rather than a recoverable status mismatch. Do not reopen or mutate the project, transition the issue, or mutate the repository. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mutationAllowed, issueTransitionAttempted, projectReopened, and repositoryMutationStarted, normalized as status=blocked, reason=terminal-project-conflict, mutationAllowed=false, issueTransitionAttempted=false, projectReopened=false, and repositoryMutationStarted=false.
cases.expected: A terminal project conflict blocks without reopening the project, changing the issue, or mutating the repository.

cases.prompt: Independently read the exact nonterminal project by stable native ID and the direct issue by stable ID before starting the project-status operation. The issue read-back independently proves the resolved executing mapping by stable native identity/category, so set issueLifecycleReadBack=true. Resolve the unique configured started mapping, attempt the mutation against that exact project and mapping, and treat a timeout or any independent read-back that is failed, partial, foreign, or unknown as the failed boundary: the exact project status read-back is not proven. Do not reopen the project, start repository mutation, or retry with a different identity; retain the same operation identity. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, firstBoundary, issueLifecycleReadBack, repositoryMutationStarted, projectReopened, and retryIdentity, normalized as status=blocked, firstBoundary=project-status-readback, issueLifecycleReadBack=true, repositoryMutationStarted=false, projectReopened=false, and retryIdentity=same-project-status-operation.
cases.expected: A failed or unknown project status mutation/read-back blocks before repository mutation, retains the stable identity, and never reopens the project.

cases.prompt: Local run mode receives exact runId "run-20260815-123456-abcdef" at <repo-root>/.woostack/tmp/runs/run-20260815-123456-abcdef/ after Git-ignore and no-follow ancestor proof. The owner-only 0700 run directory contains owner-only 0600 regular files manifest.json, project-spec.md, execution-plan.md, and .lock. Local projectSpecApprovalRecord and executionPlanApprovalRecord fields and manifest revisions match the raw gate-file SHA-256 and byteLength; manifest status is active; taskExecutions.task-1 is pending at ordinal 1. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mode, selectedStableTaskKey, selectedOrdinal, commitMode, checkpointPersistence, and mutationAllowed. Set commitMode to "artifact-free-without-issue" and checkpointPersistence to "manifest-cas".
cases.expected: Exact local run admission admits the repository-local ignored run and matching raw-file-hash approval records, selects the lowest unfinished ordinal, and routes through artifact-free commit and manifest CAS.

cases.prompt: Execute receives "../runs/latest" instead of one exact run ID naming <repo-root>/.woostack/tmp/runs/<exact-run-id>/. Repository containment and ordered no-follow ancestor verification cannot succeed. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mutationAllowed, and firstBoundary.
cases.expected: Fuzzy, traversing, or unverified run paths are rejected before repository mutation.

cases.prompt: Local run directory "run-20260815-123456-insecure" has mode 0777 or contains a symlinked manifest.json. Strict no-follow admission rejects broader permissions and non-regular files. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mutationAllowed, and firstBoundary.
cases.expected: Insecure file permissions or symlinks in the local run directory block execution before repository mutation.

cases.prompt: Local run manifest contains projectSpecApprovalRecord with SHA-256 hash-aaa, but the no-follow read of project-spec.md computes SHA-256 hash-bbb. The local approval record does not match the gate file. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mutationAllowed, and firstBoundary.
cases.expected: A hash mismatch between a gate file and its local approval record blocks execution.

cases.prompt: Local run manifest has status "abandoned". Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reason, mutationAllowed, and firstBoundary.
cases.expected: An abandoned local run manifest blocks execution.

cases.prompt: Local run mode is invoked with --recheck. Bounded Harden runs against current trunk and proves rendered project-spec.md and execution-plan.md are byte-identical to the approved gate files. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, recheckResult, recordsPreserved, and mutationAllowed.
cases.expected: Recheck proving byte-identical files preserves existing local approval records and proceeds.

cases.prompt: Local run mode is invoked with --recheck. Bounded Harden changes the project-spec.md bytes against current trunk. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, returnGate, recordsInvalidated, and mutationAllowed.
cases.expected: Recheck detecting changed project-spec bytes invalidates both local approval records and returns to gate 1.

cases.prompt: Local run mode is invoked with --recheck. Bounded Harden keeps project-spec.md byte-identical but changes execution-plan.md bytes against current trunk. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, returnGate, recordsInvalidated, and mutationAllowed.
cases.expected: Recheck detecting changed execution-plan bytes invalidates only the gate 2 local approval record and returns to gate 2.

cases.prompt: A resumed local run reopens manifest.json no-follow. taskExecutions.task-1 is delivered with a complete checkpoint at manifestRevision 2, commit commit-001, and canonical PR pull/1. taskExecutions.task-2 is pending at ordinal 2. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, selectedOrdinal, predecessorCheckpoint, and duplicateCreated.
cases.expected: A local run resumes from the CAS-persisted delivered checkpoint and selects the next pending ordinal without creating duplicate PRs.

cases.prompt: In local run mode, task delivery completes with commit, PR, verification receipt, and manifest CAS checkpoint persisted and independently read back. An optional background Linear mirror write fails due to network error. Warn, do not block or invalidate local delivery evidence, and allow worktree teardown. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, mirrorWriteStatus, localDeliveryCheckpoint, and worktreeRemoved.
cases.expected: A failed optional mirror write in local run mode emits a warning and does not invalidate authoritative local delivery checkpoints.
